gui.nydomod.ninja_card.nature_desc.futon: Wind Release. Sharpens chakra into cutting gusts of pressurized air.
gui.nydomod.ninja_card.nature_desc.suito: Water Release. Shapes flowing water — the most versatile base for kekkei genkai.
gui.nydomod.ninja_card.nature_desc.doton: Earth Release. Hardens chakra into stone and soil for defense and control.
gui.nydomod.ninja_card.nature_desc.raito: Lightning Release. Charges chakra into piercing, high-speed electricity.
gui.nydomod.ninja_card.nature_desc.shaku: Fire and Wind condensed into controllable suns. Build desiccation with directed hits and consume it in a solar convergence. Water dissipates the heat.
gui.nydomod.ninja_card.nature_desc.futto: Fire and Water: shape the fight with corrosive mist, recover pressure through condensation, then spend it to close distance, strike or release steam.
gui.nydomod.ninja_card.nature_desc.hyoto: Ice Release. Wind and Water crystallized into unbreakable ice.
gui.nydomod.ninja_card.nature_desc.jiton: Magnet Release. Wind and Earth bent into powerful magnetic fields.
gui.nydomod.ninja_card.nature_desc.yooto: Lava Release. Fire and Earth melted into flowing molten rock.
gui.nydomod.ninja_card.nature_desc.mokut: Wood Release. Water and Earth grown into living wood — the legendary bloodline.
gui.nydomod.ninja_card.nature_desc.ranto: Storm Release. Water and Lightning coiled into guided energy beams.
gui.nydomod.ninja_card.nature_desc.bakut: Explosion Release. Earth and Lightning charged into detonating chakra.
gui.nydomod.ninja_card.nature_desc.jinto: Dust Release. Fire, Earth and Wind — a Kekkei Tota that disintegrates matter.
gui.nydomod.ninja_card.nature_desc.inton: Yin Release. Spiritual chakra that gives form to imagination — the ground for Dark and beyond.
gui.nydomod.ninja_card.nature_desc.shoto: Crystal Release. Lightning and Wind ordered into razor-sharp crystalline structures.
gui.nydomod.ninja_card.nature_desc.koton: Steel Release. Fire and Earth tempered into near-unbreakable living metal.
gui.nydomod.ninja_card.nature_desc.meito: Dark Release. Water and Yin that absorb and convert chakra.
gui.nydomod.ninja_card.nature_desc.swift: Swift Release. Lightning and Wind fused into blinding, untraceable speed.

advancements.rinneganawakened.title: Rinnegan Awakened

tutorial.nydomod.complete: Ninja training complete. This tutorial will not appear again.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.ninja_card.title: Know Your Ninja
tutorial.nydomod.stage.ninja_card.body: Open the Ninja Card and review the Overview that the server built from your real character.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.jutsu_pack.title: Prepare your combat loadout
tutorial.nydomod.stage.jutsu_pack.body: Open Preparation in the Ninja Card to organize the six visible jutsu positions and the techniques ready inside each one.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.combat_mode.title: Enter Taijutsu
tutorial.nydomod.stage.combat_mode.body: Press %s once to enter Combat Mode. Taijutsu and your Jutsu Row activate together.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.light_attack.body: With Taijutsu selected, press %s once. Only an attack accepted by the server completes this step.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.heavy_attack.body: Press %s + %s once to perform a Heavy. Moving forward turns it into a launcher.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.dodge.title: Dodge
tutorial.nydomod.stage.dodge.body: Double-tap any movement direction once. A valid server-side dash completes this step.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.guard.title: Guard
tutorial.nydomod.stage.guard.body: Hold %s once while free to act. Guard must become active on the server.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.air_combat.title: Air Combat
tutorial.nydomod.stage.air_combat.launch: Move forward and press %s + %s to launch an opponent. Progress: 0/2.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.air_combat.chase: Launcher confirmed. Double-tap a movement direction during the chase window. Progress: 1/2.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.obtain_jutsu.body: Learn a technique from a valid scroll. An owned, server-enabled jutsu completes this step.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.train_jutsu.title: Practise Your First Jutsu
tutorial.nydomod.stage.train_jutsu.body: Cast the technique you just learned once. It already works at zero Jutsu XP; successful use begins its mastery.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.change_jutsu.body: Use 1–6 to select Taijutsu or a Jutsu Row slot; Up/Down cycles techniques inside a scroll.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.cast_jutsu.title: Cast a Jutsu
tutorial.nydomod.stage.cast_jutsu.body: Hold %s until the hand signs finish, then release. Only a successful cast completes training.
tutorial.nydomod.introduction: You are now a ninja. Open your Ninja Card to understand your rank, level, health, chakra, combat attributes and Shinobi Preparation, where you organize the disciplines you carry into combat.
tutorial.nydomod.introduction.controls: NYDO teaches one real action at a time and permanently remembers each completed lesson. /nydotutorial explain repeats the details; /nydotutorial skip disables training.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.ninja_card.object: Press %s and open your Ninja Card.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.ninja_card.explai: Overview is the server-backed summary of your rank, ninja level, health, chakra, combat attributes and progression.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.ninja_card.tip: Hover the radar axes for their breakdown. The other tabs contain your progression systems; the same key reopens the card anytime.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.jutsu_pack.object: In the Ninja Card, select Preparation. Press %s to reopen the card if needed.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.jutsu_pack.explai: Preparation numbers only the six editable disciplines as 1–6. Taijutsu remains automatic and hidden here; each discipline can expose up to four learned techniques.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.jutsu_pack.tip: You do not need to fill every MAX JUTSU seal. Fewer prepared techniques can make a build faster to cycle and easier to master.
tutorial.nydomod.card_coach.jutsu_pack.o: Select the highlighted Preparation tab above.
tutorial.nydomod.card_coach.jutsu_pack.t: Review the seven combat positions, then open Preparation to organize disciplines and MAX JUTSU techniques.
tutorial.nydomod.air_launcher_confirmed: Launcher confirmed — chase before the air window closes!
tutorial.nydomod.stage.combat_mode.expla: Combat Mode activates NYCombat and the Jutsu Row as one synchronized state. It gives attacks, guard, dodges and jutsu selection a single control context.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.combat_mode.tip: Press the same key again whenever you want to return to normal exploration controls.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.light_attack.expl: Light attacks begin your authored combo route. The lesson advances only after the server accepts and starts a real attack.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.light_attack.tip: Further clicks can be buffered during the transition window; wildly clicking outside it will not improve the chain.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.heavy_attack.expl: A Heavy trades speed for impact, hitstun and guard pressure. Holding forward changes the grounded Heavy into a launcher.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.heavy_attack.tip: Use a neutral Heavy for direct pressure; hold forward when you intentionally want to begin an air route.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.dodge.explain: A valid dodge spends its server-authoritative charge and movement stamina, then applies the matching directional impulse.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.dodge.tip: You cannot begin a normal dodge while guarding. Watch the blue dodge pips beside the Taijutsu HUD.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.guard.explain: Guard reduces incoming damage but builds pressure on its meter. If stability is exhausted, the defender can suffer a guard break.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.guard.tip: Starting Guard close to impact can produce a Timed Guard, a stronger defensive outcome than holding it forever.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.air_combat.locked: Press %s and select Basic Taijutsu to practice an authored air route.
Your current style has no shared Air Chase route. NYDO does not invent incompatible moves for styles whose combat identity uses a different route.
Your current style is not lost. Select it again from the skill tree after finishing this lesson.
Press %s and unlock %s for your current style.
Air Chase is progression-gated. The tutorial pauses here instead of asking for an action your character has not learned.
Train Taijutsu to gain combat levels and skill points, then purchase the highlighted prerequisite.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.air_combat.launch: In Combat Mode, hold %s and press %s + %s. Hit a nearby target. Progress: 0/2.
Forward changes Heavy into a Launcher. Only confirmed contact lifts the target and opens the short Air Chase window.
Use a living target on open, level ground. A miss, excess distance or blocked path will not open a usable chase.
As the target rises, double-tap %s, %s, %s or %s before the purple cue ends. Progress: 1/2.
During the confirmed Launcher window, the same directional dash becomes Air Chase and pursues that exact target.
Air Chase is available once per Launcher. In the air, press %s for aerial light; hold %s and press %s + %s for aerial heavy.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.obtain_jutsu.obje: Find or buy a Jutsu Scroll, hold it in your main hand and press %s to begin Hand Seal Training.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.obtain_jutsu.expl: Jutsu Scrolls come from structure chests, mob drops and Scroll Shops for Ryō. Complete the seal training to unlock its technique and add the discipline to your Jutsu Arsenal.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.obtain_jutsu.tip: Training has three lives. The teaching scroll is consumed on success or after all lives are lost, and some techniques require specific progression.
tutorial.nydomod.obtain_jutsu.already_ow: NYDO found a technique you already own. To learn more, obtain Jutsu Scrolls from structures, mobs or Scroll Shops, then use one from your main hand and complete Hand Seal Training.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.train_jutsu.objec: Cast the jutsu you just learned once. No initial Jutsu XP is required.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.train_jutsu.expla: Learning makes a technique usable immediately. Jutsu XP is mastery earned after learning: it improves charge speed, power and each jutsu's authored bonuses. Vanilla XP never substitutes for Jutsu XP.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.train_jutsu.tip: Successful casts train the selected technique. You may also practise with its release item in the offhand, but that is optional rather than an unlock gate.
tutorial.nydomod.train_jutsu.already_mas: NYDO found an already-trained technique and preserved its progress.
tutorial.nydomod.train_jutsu.already_pra: NYDO found a technique you have already practised and preserved that progress.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.change_jutsu.obje: Choose a Jutsu Row slot, or use %s / %s to cycle techniques inside the selected scroll.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.change_jutsu.expl: The row chooses a scroll; cycling chooses the armed technique inside it. The HUD, virtual hand and server selection always update together.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.change_jutsu.tip: Number keys or mouse wheel select row slots. %s/%s change scroll; %s/%s change technique; hold %s for the radial wheel.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.cast_jutsu.object: Select a learned technique, hold %s through its hand signs, then release.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.cast_jutsu.explai: A cast succeeds only when its chakra, mastery, cooldown and technique-specific conditions are valid. Failed attempts never finish training.
tutorial.nydomod.stage.cast_jutsu.tip: Keep holding until the hand-sign sequence is ready. Releasing early may cancel or produce insufficient power.

dialogue.nydomod.sage_master.not_chosen: Not yet. The mountain does not choose through pride or strength. Return when your shinobi path has reached rank B.
dialogue.nydomod.sage_master.chosen: Your chakra can now brush against something that is not yours. If you accept, you will not learn a technique: you will learn to remain alive while nature enters you.
dialogue.nydomod.sage_master.active.sage: First learn to listen. Crouch and touch the four glowing courtyard seals. Then crouch at the center for 20 seconds without moving or taking damage. Return and tell me what you felt.

message.nydomod.sage_trial.guardian_gale: Needle: impact in one second. Leave the cloud marking your position.
message.nydomod.sage_trial.center_requir: Stand at the exact Kumite center on sanctuary stone, crouch, and remain still.
message.nydomod.sage_trial.board_require: Crouch at the Board's central stone focus; remain grounded, unmounted, still and unharmed.
dialogue.nydomod.sage_master.active.sage: Crouch on the Board and listen to wind for 20 seconds; stay inside the sacred pool for 15 seconds; crouch beside the roots for 15 seconds. Finally climb onto the pink leaves. Follow each stage's signals and return.

Return to the court. Move out of Stone's wave or jump; sidestep Torrent's line; leave Needle's marked point. Hit the guardian within six seconds after dodging. You may then defeat them. Learn all three forms and return: no wildlife hunting or waiting out a timer.
The three guardians taught you fragments. Now crouch on the court seal and invoke Gama no Ishin. Read and counter each of his three changing forms, defeat him, then bring me his judgment.

You can listen, balance and respond. Crouch at the stone focus on the Board for two real minutes. Looking around is allowed. Moving, taking damage, flying, mounting or disconnecting restarts the attempt. Toad Sage Mode awakens right there.
dialogue.nydomod.sage_master.complete: The mountain knows your name now. Senjutsu is not a prize; it is a responsibility that walks with you.

village.nydomod.title: Konoha · Hidden Leaf Village
village.nydomod.wanted: Leaf alert! The guards will respond to your attack.
village.nydomod.closed: Konoha has suspended your missions and trade. Reputation: %s.
village.nydomod.purchase_denied: The village has suspended your trading privileges.
village.nydomod.locate: Konoha center: %s, %s, %s (Overworld; newly generated Eternal Leaf terrain).
mission.nydomod.konoha_first_lesson.prac: Land 12 melee hits on the wooden dummies
village.nydomod.dialogue.gate_captain: I am Kotetsu. Meet Iruka at the academy, then report to the Hokage. Our gate recognizes peaceful visitors. Help the residents to earn their trust; attacking them closes our services and brings the guards.
village.nydomod.dialogue.gate_guard: Izumo, gate guard. Check our patrol stations and bring back a report. Once the village trusts you, night watch duty becomes available: visit the west post, the main gate and the east post after sunset.
village.nydomod.dialogue.hokage: The Will of Fire lives in how we care for each other. Every assignment depends on your ninja level and the missions you have turned in. Your current progress determines your next step.
village.nydomod.dialogue.iruka: Welcome to the academy. Kakashi is at the eastern training grounds. Practice precise strikes on the wooden dummies, then return here. The dojo offers further training once you finish your first lesson.
village.nydomod.dialogue.kakashi: The bell is yours if you can take it without attacking. Accept my test, then sneak-interact to begin. Watch where I look, approach from behind and keep your main hand empty.
village.nydomod.dialogue.medic: Every bandage matters. Bring cloth and herbs for the hospital. Trusted ninja can escort a recovering patient to the inn: stay close, use the streets and protect them until you arrive.
village.nydomod.dialogue.ramen: Welcome to Ichiraku! A warm meal keeps the next guard shift going. Bring wheat and eggs, or pick up provisions before heading out.
village.nydomod.dialogue.weapons: Check your equipment before leaving. The forge needs iron and coal. A dependable weapon starts with dependable materials.
village.nydomod.dialogue.outfitter: Uniforms wear out on every mission. Bring wool and leather and help us prepare the next shift.
village.nydomod.dialogue.scrolls: Scrolls preserve generations of knowledge. Take your time choosing the tools for your training.
village.nydomod.dialogue.courier: The archives need a reply delivered to the gate. Ready for a harder route? Climb the western rooftops and cross four marked decks within two minutes. Each checkpoint must be reached in order, on foot.
village.nydomod.dialogue.archivist: Our records carry the memory of the village. Paper and ink keep that memory alive. The Hokage office stands at the end of the main avenue.
village.nydomod.dialogue.innkeeper: A bed and a warm meal await returning teams. The canal bridges lead back to the southern residential streets.
village.nydomod.dialogue.patrol: Keep the streets clear. We watch our sector, respond to threats and protect peaceful residents.
village.nydomod.dialogue.resident: The morning belongs to work, the evening to our neighbors. I go home at night. The market is on the main avenue; the garden is west and the training grounds east.
mission.nydomod.konoha_arrival.title: A Place in the Leaf
mission.nydomod.konoha_arrival.desc: Meet Iruka and the Hokage, then return to Kotetsu to register as a Leaf member.
mission.nydomod.konoha_first_lesson.desc: Speak to Kakashi, land 12 melee hits on the wooden dummies and report to Iruka.
mission.nydomod.konoha_bell_route.title: Kakashi: The Bell Test
mission.nydomod.konoha_bell_route.desc: Accept the test, then sneak-interact with Kakashi to start a 90-second attempt. Watch his turns. Approach from behind with an empty main hand, on the ground and within 2.8 blocks. Stay concealed there for one second, then sneak-interact again to take the bell. Do not attack him. Leaving the arena, taking damage or logging out ends the attempt. Speak normally to Kakashi afterward to claim your reward.
mission.nydomod.konoha_will_of_fire.desc: Listen to Aoi and Hana, gather bread for relief and report to the Hokage. Requires ninja level 10.
mission.nydomod.konoha_supplies.title: Ingredients for Ichiraku
mission.nydomod.konoha_supplies.desc: Bring wheat and eggs to Teuchi. Follow the quantities in your mission objectives.
mission.nydomod.konoha_medicine.title: Bandages and First Aid
mission.nydomod.konoha_medicine.desc: Bring white wool and dandelions to Aoi at the hospital.
mission.nydomod.konoha_forge.title: Keep the Forge Burning
mission.nydomod.konoha_forge.desc: Bring iron ingots and coal to Tenten at the weapon shop.
mission.nydomod.konoha_dispatch.title: Leaf Correspondence
mission.nydomod.konoha_dispatch.desc: Visit Sora at the archives and Kotetsu at the gate, then return to Hana.
mission.nydomod.konoha_perimeter.title: Perimeter Patrol
mission.nydomod.konoha_perimeter.desc: Inspect the three marked stations and return to Izumo. Requires ninja level 10.
mission.nydomod.konoha_uniforms.title: Uniforms for the Next Shift
mission.nydomod.konoha_uniforms.desc: Deliver white wool and leather to Maki at the tailor shop.
mission.nydomod.konoha_archives.title: Memory of the Village
mission.nydomod.konoha_archives.desc: Deliver paper and ink sacs to Sora at the archives.
mission.nydomod.konoha_field_watch.title: Forest Watch
mission.nydomod.konoha_field_watch.desc: Visit the southern forest clearing, defeat spiders and return to Kakashi. Requires ninja level 10.
village.nydomod.dialogue.envoy: Lost the village trust? Wait until the alert ends, then supply oak logs and iron to repair the damage. Restitution restores 100 reputation once per game day and awards no money or experience.
mission.nydomod.konoha_restitution.title: Make Amends to the Leaf
mission.nydomod.konoha_restitution.desc: This is a separate reputation repair task. After the alert ends, deliver 64 oak logs and 16 iron ingots to the envoy outside the gate. Restores 100 reputation while services are restricted, once per Minecraft day. Materials are consumed when you claim.
village.nydomod.card.restitution: Services suspended · seek the envoy outside the gate
village.nydomod.card.member: Leaf member · aid residents to earn their trust
village.nydomod.card.visitor: Visitor · register with Kotetsu at the main gate
village.nydomod.activity.race_reset: Time expired. Return to the first rooftop to try again.
village.nydomod.dialogue.florist: Flowers belong at our windows and memorials. Bring poppies and bone meal to help keep this neighborhood blooming.
village.nydomod.dialogue.baker: The ovens start before sunrise. Sugar and cocoa will help me prepare something special for the academy.
village.nydomod.dialogue.trainer: A good exchange needs footwork. Strike the practice partner from alternating sides, leaving a second between hits. The drill is nonlethal; learn to reposition instead of standing still.
village.nydomod.dialogue.guildmaster: Knowing the village is part of serving it. Visit the market, the garden bridge and the canal, then meet the florist and baker. Every district supports the next.
mission.nydomod.konoha_roof_run.title: Above the Streets
mission.nydomod.konoha_roof_run.desc: Reach four rooftop decks in order within two minutes. Start at the westernmost deck; report to Hana.
mission.nydomod.konoha_sparring.title: Footwork and Timing
mission.nydomod.konoha_sparring.desc: Land 12 measured hits on the practice partner, alternating sides with a second between strikes. Return to the dojo trainer.
mission.nydomod.konoha_night_watch.title: Lanterns after Sunset
mission.nydomod.konoha_night_watch.desc: At night, inspect the west post, the main gate and the east post in order. Requires 100 reputation points (10% of 1000). Return to Izumo.
mission.nydomod.konoha_river_escort.desc: Escort the hospital patient to the inn. Stay close and protect them. Requires 100 reputation points (10% of 1000). Report to Aoi.
mission.nydomod.konoha_districts.title: The People behind the Village
mission.nydomod.konoha_districts.desc: Visit the market, garden bridge and canal, then meet the florist and baker. Report to the guild steward.
mission.nydomod.konoha_flowers.title: Color at Every Window
mission.nydomod.konoha_flowers.desc: Bring poppies and bone meal to the florist.
mission.nydomod.konoha_bakery.title: Before the Morning Bell
mission.nydomod.konoha_bakery.desc: Bring sugar and cocoa beans to the baker.
mission.nydomod.konoha_night_watch.goal: Night watch stations, west to east

village.nydomod.dialogue.guard_member: Welcome home, shinobi of Konoha. Your ninja registration is recognized. Report to Iruka and the Hokage for your assignments. Protect our residents: harming them lowers your reputation and raises the alarm.
mission.nydomod.konoha_road_to_konoha.de: A sealed route scroll starts your journey. Become a ninja and carry 32 oak logs and 8 iron ingots to unseal its map. Follow the red gate marker, speak to the gate captain and report this mission to him. The supplies are consumed only when you claim the reward; keep them for delivery. Then accept Arrival in Konoha from the captain.
mission.nydomod.konoha_river_teacher.tit: The River and the Will of Fire
mission.nydomod.konoha_river_teacher.des: The Hokage sends you to Jiraiya at the sheltered northern bank of the eastern river. Hear his advice, inspect the two riverside viewing decks marked by the mission navigator, then return to the Hokage with 12 sheets of paper for the field register. Paper is consumed on delivery.
mission.nydomod.konoha_jiraiya_river.des: Bring Jiraiya 8 raw cod and 4 ink sacs for his riverside camp and travel notes. Fishing is a peaceful way to gather the supplies. Report to Jiraiya; supplies are consumed on claim. Repeatable after one Minecraft day.
mission.nydomod.konoha_household_deliver: Collect 16 sheets of paper, visit the silk weaver and the paper scholar at their homes, then speak to the archivist. Return to the guildmaster to deliver the paper and claim your reward. Follow the mission navigator to each household.
village.nydomod.dialogue.jiraiya: A village lives through the people who care for it. Sit by the water, observe the forest, and bring back something useful. Even a great shinobi must learn to listen.
village.nydomod.map.ninja_required: Become a ninja before opening this sealed route.

mission.nydomod.konoha_jiraiya_provision: Jiraiya I: a pack worth carrying

Before I trust you with a secret, show me you can supply a camp. Bring 48 oak logs, 32 cobblestone and 8 raw cod. Also catch fish yourself 6 times after accepting: bought fish can feed us, but cannot prove patience. Keep the supplies until you report to me; they are consumed together when you claim.
mission.nydomod.konoha_jiraiya_water.tit: Jiraiya II: the river will not wait
mission.nydomod.konoha_jiraiya_water.des: Move across the surface of the Konoha river for 120 seconds. Your ninja passives must be awake: reach ordinary experience level 10 once. Swimming, flying, riding and standing still do not count. Rest on the bank whenever needed; earned seconds remain. Bring 24 sugar cane for our paper and report to me.
mission.nydomod.konoha_jiraiya_scout.des: Survey three riverbank stations in order; the mission navigator points to the next. Observe the first by day, the second at night, and the third at any time. Crouch and remain still for 30 uninterrupted seconds at each. Movement or damage resets only that observation. Return with 24 paper and 8 ink sacs. Your reward is a scroll for learning Shadow Clone through the normal training system.
mission.nydomod.konoha_jiraiya_shadow.ti: Jiraiya IV: three shadows, one will
mission.nydomod.konoha_jiraiya_shadow.de: Actually learn Shadow Clone; an unread scroll is not enough. Use the scroll I gave you or another normal learning route. Keep your owned, learned jutsu in your inventory or Jutsu Pack. Successfully cast at each of the three marked riverbank stations, in order and at least 10 seconds apart, while standing on the ground. Return with the learned jutsu to receive the Rasengan training scroll.
mission.nydomod.konoha_jiraiya_spiral.ti: Jiraiya V: the spiral and the provisions
mission.nydomod.konoha_jiraiya_spiral.de: Learn Rasengan through its normal training. Form it successfully at the three marked stations in order, at least 10 seconds apart, with your feet on the ground. You do not need to hurt villagers. Also prepare 24 baked potatoes and 16 white wool for the expedition. Deliver them while you still possess your learned Rasengan. My final mission requires ninja level 25; ordinary experience is not a substitute.
mission.nydomod.konoha_jiraiya_journey.t: Jiraiya VI: the chart of six landscapes
mission.nydomod.konoha_jiraiya_journey.d: At ninja level 25, after reporting all five trials, speak to the toad beside Jiraiya with one free inventory slot. Reverse summoning takes you to Snowy Mountain Pass. Open its chart: the mountain is marked in the same atlas as Konoha. Survey all six biomes, including Frozen High Peaks, by moving on foot for 30 seconds in each. Visit Frozen, then continue through Snowy, Thawing Ridges, Weathered Peaks, Myoboku Highlands and Sage Spires. Finish your own journey and report to Fukasaku to begin his campaign. Return to Jiraiya if you lose the chart or need passage to Snowy again.

mission.nydomod.jiraiya.trespass: Intruder! You lack the mountain's authorization. Its guardians will attack until you leave the sanctuary.

dialogue.nydomod.bond.ready: Do not confuse a seal with an agreement.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.greeting: So you are my jinchūriki. Speak. I want to know who shares this body with me.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.loan_accepted: I am transferring chakra to you. Use “Contain chakra” to stop the transfer.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.self_preservation: I will give you enough. Do not mistake my interest in surviving for trust.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.repair_loan: A clear limit this time. Your next actions matter more than your promise.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.boundary_reminder: That is the flow we agreed on. You can end it, too.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.forced: You asked for an agreement and ended up taking it by force. I will remember.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.forced_warning: Now you know how to take more. That does not mean you have learned to live with me.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.kept: You stopped when you could still have demanded more. I noticed that.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.kept_recent: Yes, you honored the limit. You do not need to repeat it endlessly for me to remember.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.kept_pressure: There was pressure, and you still regulated the flow. That was your decision.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.finished: That is the end of this loan. What comes next is something we must agree on.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.stopped_early: You closed the flow. Now practice holding it briefly before stopping.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.forced_stopped: You stopped pulling. Good. But closing the flow does not erase what happened.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.interrupted: The current was cut off. I will not confuse an interruption with betrayal.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.capacity_reached: Your reserve cannot take any more. There is no point in pushing.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.refusal: The limits we agreed on did not matter to you. Face that before asking for more.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.exhausted: This is not an argument. We are asking too much; let the body recover.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.reserve_low: My reserve is not endless. I need to recover what we used.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.repair_promised: A promise does not repair the damage. Ask for little and show me you can respect it.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.repair_reminder: I am still waiting for you to honor the limit you offered to respect.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.repair_kept: You kept your word this time. It does not erase the past, but it is a start.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.no_repair_needed: Do not invent a debt. If we are to understand each other, act clearly.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.no_memory: We have not lived through enough together to speak of that yet.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.cautious_0: I can listen without agreeing with you. They are not the same thing.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.cautious_1: Your seal contains chakra. It does not contain my decisions.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.cautious_2: Do not measure your strength only by what you can tear from me.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.warming_0: I am beginning to recognize how you regulate the flow. You no longer do everything blindly.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.warming_1: We can disagree. I prefer that to a promise you have no intention of keeping.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.warming_2: I need to repeat the same limit less often. That matters.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.distrust_0: I have heard your words. I am still waiting for something different in your actions.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.distrust_1: You know how to ask permission. I also know you can ignore the answer.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.distrust_2: Do not ask for trust while treating my limits as obstacles.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_met: I remember our first contact. We still had everything to prove.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_boundary_ag: We agreed on an amount, not access to everything I have.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_boundary_ke: I remember you closing the flow yourself. I did not have to impose it.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_forced: I remember when the agreement stopped mattering to you and you pulled harder.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_repair_prom: I remember when you promised to respect my limits again.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_repair_kept: After the breach, you kept an agreement. I have not overlooked that.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_transfer_fi: The loan ended as we intended. No more, no less.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_interrupted: There was an interruption. I will not attribute an intention I could not observe.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_under_press: After taking that attack, you still chose to contain the chakra.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.help_offer: Your body is giving out. You can ask for help; you do not have to carry all of this alone.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.tired: I'm still recovering. Do not mistake silence for consent.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.greeting_v0: I am listening. We can talk before you ask for chakra.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.greeting_v1: We share this body, but I have a will of my own. Start by listening.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.greeting_v2: If you want my help, ask. Do not try to tear my chakra away.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.loan_accepted_v0: I have agreed to lend you chakra. Receive it without forcing the seal.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.loan_accepted_v1: The transfer has begun. Receiving chakra does not guarantee control of the cloak.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.loan_accepted_v2: I will give you the agreed amount. Stop the transfer if you have enough.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.kept_v0: There was still chakra left to receive, and you stopped. You are beginning to understand the limit.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.kept_v1: You did not need me to make you stop. That matters more than another promise.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.kept_v2: You asked for little and respected our agreement. That gives us something to build on.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.kept_recent_v0: You regulated it well again. You do not have to prove the same thing every moment.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.kept_recent_v1: I saw the effort. Let what you learned settle instead of pushing yourself again.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.kept_recent_v2: You stopped in time. You do not have to repeat it without a break for me to remember.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.forced_v0: We agreed on an amount. You just took more without my consent.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.forced_v1: You called your request a plea for help. Now you are turning it into a demand.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.forced_v2: You will get more chakra, not my trust. They are not the same thing.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.repair_promised_v0: I heard you. The next stream will be small; what you do with it will say more.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.repair_promised_v1: I will not erase what happened because of a few words. You can show me that you understood.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.repair_promised_v2: Start by respecting one simple boundary. I am not asking you to flatter me.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.repair_kept_v0: You followed through this time. It does not fix everything, but it is something you did, not just promised.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.repair_kept_v1: I saw you stop. We can try to rebuild this without pretending nothing happened.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.repair_kept_v2: The agreement has been kept. I will remember it alongside the mistake, not instead of it.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.repair_kept_recent: You kept your promise. I saw it; do not expect us to rebuild everything at once.
You respected the limit this time. You do not have to repeat it now to convince me.
I have not overlooked what you did. Show that same clarity when a different situation comes.
You kept your promise. I saw it; do not expect us to rebuild everything at once.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.kept_pressure_rece: There was danger, and you managed to stop. I saw it. You do not need another crisis to prove it.
You contained the chakra without losing sight of the threat. Recover now.
You held steady this time. Taking another risk immediately will not make that decision more valuable.
There was danger, and you managed to stop. I saw it. You do not need another crisis to prove it.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.help_offer_v0: You are in danger, and I can still lend you something. Ask; I will not decide for you now.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.help_offer_v1: I can open a limited stream. Let it help you get out, not make you careless.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.help_offer_v2: You have little room left. I have chakra available, but you will have to ask.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.cautious_v0: I do not expect you to agree with me on everything. I expect you to keep what you agree to.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.cautious_v1: You can be ready to fight without being ready to handle my chakra.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.cautious_v2: I am listening. Not every silence needs to become another request for power.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.cautious: I do not expect you to agree with me on everything. I expect you to keep what you agree to.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.warming_v0: I am beginning to trust you. Keep honoring our agreements.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.warming_v1: We understand each other better. That helps, but the cloak can still overwhelm you.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.warming_v2: We can share chakra. Listen to my warnings and do not take more than agreed.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.warming: I am beginning to distinguish your decisions from your impulses. Keep giving me reasons to do so.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.distrust_v0: I do not trust you yet. Respect my limits and keep the agreements you accept.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.distrust_v1: I can hear you out without trusting you. Show me through your actions that I can.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.distrust_v2: Asking for more power will not settle our distrust. Start by keeping an agreement.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.distrust: What concerns me is not that you make mistakes. It is that you call a repeated decision an accident.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.finished_v0: The transfer is over. Do not mistake the chakra you received for an endless reserve.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.finished_v1: That was the agreed amount. You can use it without immediately asking for another stream.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.finished_v2: You have that portion now. Letting it finish did not break our agreement.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_trust_v0: My trust grows when you fulfill requests and agreements. Forcing my chakra damages it.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_trust_v1: Talking helps us understand each other, but repeating a conversation does not increase my trust.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_trust_v2: Shared experiences build our friendship. To trust you, I also need you to keep our agreements.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_trust: You will not earn my trust by repeating a phrase. Respect an agreement, and I will have a fact to remember.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_control_v0: Ask for chakra. After receiving three pulses, stop the transfer before it finishes to practice control.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_control_v1: Activating the cloak and controlling it are different. Your experience and our relationship improve your chances.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_control_v2: Releasing more tails increases the risk of losing control. Check the chance before switching.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_control: Ask for a small stream. Receive three pulses, then contain it before it ends to practice.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_seal_v0: Integrity shows the condition of the seal. Opening shows how much chakra it is letting through.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_seal_v1: If someone restrains you and undoes the formula, I will be free. Our relationship affects what I do next; it does not give the extractor ownership of me.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_seal_v2: Stopping my chakra closes the flow, but it does not repair damaged closures. Use Four Symbols while crouching to reinforce your own seal.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_seal: Integrity shows the condition of the containment. It measures neither my trust nor a chance of escape.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_intent_v0: I want to decide what happens to my own strength. Sharing a body does not mean surrendering my will.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_intent_v1: I want to survive too. If I intervene to save us, it does not mean you already control my power.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_intent_v2: I do not need you to worship me. I need you to understand that you are dealing with someone, not a tool.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_intent: I want to decide what happens to my own strength. Sharing a body does not mean surrendering my will.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_repair_v0: We can start with one concrete promise and a limited stream. Keeping it matters more than repeating it.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_repair_v1: Ask to repair the agreement, then respect the next loan. It does not erase everything, but it opens a path.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_repair_v2: Even if I trusted you before, taking more is still a breach. We can repair it without pretending it never happened.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.explain_repair: We can start with one concrete promise and a limited stream. Keeping it matters more than repeating it.

gui.nydomod.inner.title: Inner encounter
gui.nydomod.inner.lesson: Regulation drill: three rounds of charging, evasion and containment. This is not a fight to the death.
gui.nydomod.inner.learned: Regulation learned. Normal loans last 16 pulses and can supply a little more. Repeating the drill awards no more XP.
gui.nydomod.inner.phase.preparing: Preparing the encounter. Stay near the bed.
gui.nydomod.inner.phase.ready: Select Request chakra and execute it to start the next round.
gui.nydomod.inner.phase.charging: Hold the charge. Do not contain it yet. Get ready to move.
gui.nydomod.inner.phase.warning: LEAVE THE ORANGE CIRCLE before the pulse. Move away; jumping inside it does not count.
gui.nydomod.inner.phase.contain: Use CONTAIN now, before the window closes.
gui.nydomod.inner.phase.complete: Drill complete. You will return shortly.
gui.nydomod.inner.phase.failed: Drill ended. You will return without a friendship penalty.
gui.nydomod.inner.phase.recovery: Recovering your return. You can request Wake up again.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_unavailab: First receive a loan and practice Contain, or talk after forcing one.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_invited: Kurama is waiting. Plan the visit and use a safe bed.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_armed: Visit planned for one minute. Use a bed, even during the day. Other players need not sleep.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_cancelled: Visit cancelled. You can rest normally.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_no_bond: No active bond permits this encounter.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_invalid: The data needs review. Previous progress was not erased.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_active: You are already in an encounter.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_cooldown: Wait a moment before another visit.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_busy: End the transformation or conflicting state before resting.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_unsafe: You need a free bed, firm ground, sufficient health and food, and must not be burning.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_combat: You cannot use the encounter to escape a recent fight.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_preparing: The room is being prepared in stages. Your body has not moved yet.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_preparati: Preparation cancelled: you moved away, the bed changed, or the area became unsafe.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_unavailab: The inner dimension is unavailable or the room is outside the world border.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_arena_occ: There are foreign blocks in the room. They were not overwritten; review is required.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_transfer_: The dimension transfer was denied. The visit did not complete.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_stale: That action belongs to an earlier session. Refresh the panel.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_wait: Follow the current phase before requesting another charge.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_ready: Request starts the round. Dodge the pulse, then use Contain. Three rounds complete the drill.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_charging: Charging. The circle will mark where you must not stay.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_evade: The orange zone is fixed: leave it before the pulse.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_contain_n: Valid evasion. Close the flow with Contain.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_round_kep: Round passed. You can prepare the next charge.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_too_early: It is not the containment window yet. No chakra was consumed.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_hit: The pulse caught you inside the zone. You can retry while mistakes remain.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_late: You did not contain the flow in time. Start the next round from Request.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_completed: Regulation learned; technical XP awarded once. No friendship was bought and no cloak unlocked.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_repeated: Drill completed again. Learning is retained; no additional XP reward.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_failed: The drill ended after three mistakes. The exercise did not cost friendship or inventory.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_timeout: The session timed out. You can try again during another rest.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_returned: You have returned from the encounter.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_left: You left voluntarily. There is no trust penalty.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_recovered: Return from an interrupted session recovered. Its reward was not repeated.
gui.nydomod.inner.reason.inner_interrupt: The encounter was interrupted by a state change.

dialogue.nydomod.bond.inner_invited: You know how to ask. Now learn not to lose yourself when the flow changes. Come when you rest.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.inner_ready: Ask for chakra to begin. Dodge the marked areas and stop the transfer when I tell you.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.inner_charging: Keep the transfer going for now. Be ready to dodge.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.inner_evade: That spot is no longer safe. Move.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.inner_contain_now: Now! Use “Contain chakra” to stop the transfer.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.inner_round_kept: That was a decision, not a lucky hit. Prepare again.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.inner_hit: The marked area caught you. Leave it before the impact.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.inner_late: You dodged, but stopped the chakra too late. Wait for my signal, then act immediately.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.inner_completed: You can regulate what you receive better now. Do not mistake that skill for permission to take everything.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.inner_repeated: You remember. Good. I do not have to pay you every time you repeat what you learned.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.inner_failed: Stop here. See what went wrong before demanding more of yourself.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.inner_timeout: Standing still will not solve this. Come back when you can focus.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.inner_returned: Take what you learned. Outside, you will have to decide without me marking the ground.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.inner_left: Knowing when to stop is a decision too. We will continue another time.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.inner_recovered: The conversation can wait. First, get your bearings again.
gui.nydomod.bond.reflection.title: What we experienced
gui.nydomod.bond.reflection.unseen: There is no shared experience for this conversation yet.
gui.nydomod.bond.reflection.ready: Kurama wants to discuss what you learned. Listening does not commit you to an agreement.
gui.nydomod.bond.reflection.offered: You may agree to respect the next loan or ask for space. Neither answer awards points by itself.
gui.nydomod.bond.reflection.agreed: Pending agreement: receive at least three pulses from the next loan without forcing it. You may then contain it or let it finish.
gui.nydomod.bond.reflection.distance: You asked for space. Kurama respects it: no trust was lost, and you can return to this conversation when ready.
gui.nydomod.bond.reflection.kept: You honored the shared limit. Kurama remembers it. Repeating it does not award this recognition again.
gui.nydomod.bond.reflection.broken: The agreement broke when you forced the flow. Repair the breach before proposing another; earlier recognition is never duplicated.
gui.nydomod.bond.reason.reflection_avail: A conversation about your practice is available.
gui.nydomod.bond.reason.reflection_offer: Kurama proposes an agreement. You can accept or ask for space.
gui.nydomod.bond.reason.reflection_repai: Resolve the existing breach before proposing this agreement.
gui.nydomod.bond.reason.mutual_agreed: Agreement started. A promise grants no trust: following through matters.
gui.nydomod.bond.reason.mutual_wait: The agreement awaits a regulated loan. There is no deadline or logout penalty.
gui.nydomod.bond.reason.distance_respect: You asked for space without losing trust.
gui.nydomod.bond.reason.mutual_kept: The agreement was honored. Social recognition is one-time only; it grants no extra XP.
gui.nydomod.bond.reason.mutual_kept_prac: You honored the agreement and completed a valid practice. Social recognition is one-time; XP follows its normal cooldown.
gui.nydomod.bond.reason.mutual_complete: This agreement is already complete. Trust is not bought by repeating the same scene.
gui.nydomod.bond.reason.mutual_trust: Kurama remembers a shared limit you honored.
gui.nydomod.bond.next.reflection: You can discuss the practice with Kurama. Choose whether to agree on a limit or keep some distance.
gui.nydomod.bond.next.mutual: Your next loan can demonstrate the agreement. Do not force it; after three pulses you may contain it or let it finish.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.reflection_availab: You learned to stop the flow. Now I want to know what you intend to do with that.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.reflection_offer_p: I do not need another grand promise. With the next loan, respect what we both agree to.
You can ask for space. I prefer that to pretending to listen and then pulling at my chakra.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.mutual_agreed_p06_: Good. Next time I do not want words: let your actions uphold that limit.
An agreed current. No more than I can give, and no more than you can hold.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.distance_respected: Then keep that distance. I will not call your honesty a betrayal.
You do not trust yet. I understand. When you speak again, do not pretend otherwise.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.mutual_wait_p06_0: The agreement still stands. You do not need to rush to prove it.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.mutual_kept_p06_0: This time the limit belonged to both of us. Neither had to impose it on the other.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.mutual_kept_p06_1: You could have kept pulling. You did not. That means more than the promise.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.mutual_kept_practi: You regulated the flow and respected the agreement. They are not the same thing; today you did both.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.mutual_trust_p06_0: I know you can respect a limit. That does not make us the same, but it changes this conversation.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.mutual_trust_p06_1: I no longer need to repeat what happened in that practice. You remember it too.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_shared_less: I remember how you learned to close the flow, not how long you stayed inside.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_mutual_limi: We agreed that asking did not mean taking everything. That depended on both of us.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_independenc: You asked for space instead of promising something you did not feel. I did not mistake that for an insult.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_mutual_limi: You kept the loan within the limit we agreed on. That is why I remember it, not because of its strength.
We had agreed on a limit. When you forced more, you broke more than the flow.

dialogue.nydomod.bond.instinct_onset_p07: You cannot hold yourself together. This time I will move the body.

dialogue.nydomod.bond.instinct_lost_p07_: Enough. I am taking over now.
Stay inside. I will deal with what is in front of us.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.instinct_return_p0: You have regained control of the body. Take a moment before fighting again.
You are directing your movements again. I need to rest after intervening.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.instinct_loyal_hel: Stay with me. I do not need to take your body to help you.
I will lend you strength. You remain in control: use it to get out of danger.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_body_taken_: I remember when you stopped directing your movements. Do not mistake that for learning to control them.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_body_return: I remember returning control to you. While I directed the body, you did not choose its movements.

dialogue.nydomod.bond.pact_regulate_p11_: Do not promise you will never need help. Show me you can stop after accepting it.
Ask for a small current. Receive enough, then close it yourself before it ends.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.pact_keep_limit_p1: What I offer is not an invitation to take the rest. Let us use only what we agreed.
You may let the current end. You need not interrupt it to prove anything; just do not force it.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.pact_train_togethe: Let us practice again. Not to defeat me, but so you do not depend on luck out there.
When you rest, come prepared. This time I want to see what you have learned.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.pact_stand_alone_p: I will watch how you respond without my loan. I am not asking you to die to prove your pride.
Face real threats with your own ability. If you need help, withdraw the agreement and ask.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.pact_withdrawn_p11: I would rather you change your mind than pretend you will follow through.
Withdrawing a promise in time is not the same as breaking it behind my back.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.pact_progress_p11_: I saw how you responded. One situation does not tell the whole story; we keep watching.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.pact_kept_p11_0: This time you did what we agreed. Not because the seal held you, but because you chose to.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.pact_kept_p11_1: I saw it. We can build something on decisions like that.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.pact_kept_p11_2: You do not need to repeat the promise. You just demonstrated it.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.pact_kept_recent_p: You followed through. Let me take that in; we do not need to prove the same thing every moment.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.pact_kept_variety_: I know you can repeat that exercise. I want to know you when the situation changes too.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.pact_kept_ceiling_: What you did still matters. But our relationship cannot fit into a single habit.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.pact_reminder_regu: Our agreement is still active: ask for chakra and stop the transfer after three pulses, before it finishes.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.pact_reminder_keep: We agreed to use only the chakra I offer. Do not force the transfer.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.pact_reminder_trai: The practice can wait until you are ready to rest. I will not demand that you drop everything now.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.pact_reminder_stan: Do not confuse independence with seeking a pointless death. You may change your mind.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.repair_progress_p1: That was a step. I need to see that we are not returning to the same cycle.
I am listening to what you do, not just what you say. Keep going.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.repair_wait_p11_0: You followed through this time. I will not pretend everything was repaired so quickly.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.help_automatic_p11: If I can help when danger closes in, I will. That does not make our chakra endless.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.help_warn_first_p1: I will warn you while you can still respond. If you are about to die and I can intervene, I will try to save us.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.help_warning_p11_0: You are in danger. I am warning you as agreed; find a way out or ask for help.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.instinct_protectiv: I will deal with the threat. I do not need to destroy everything to keep us alive.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.debrief_test_p11_0: That was a test. I will not call it a promise or a battle we won together.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.debrief_forced_p11: You demanded more than agreed. Strength did not give you the control you thought you had.
When you demanded more chakra, you lost control. We can discuss how to prevent it happening again.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.debrief_quiet_p11_: I did not land a hit in that episode. I will not invent a victory to reassure you.
The body returned to you. Now learn to recognize what happened before you lost it.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.debrief_danger_p11: I acted while you could not direct the body. The consequences do not vanish when you open your eyes.
Surviving an episode does not mean we should repeat it. Let us discuss how to avoid reaching the limit like that.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.close_companion_p1: I am starting to recognize your decisions without every explanation. Keep talking to me when something changes.
I do not think the same way you do. You know that does not mean you are alone.
You left me room to choose. That changed more than you think.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.loyal_companion_p1: I am not staying because you learned to cage me better. I am staying because I chose this bond too.
I do not need you to be perfect. I need us to stay honest when something breaks.
Power still has a price. The difference is that now we can decide together how to pay it.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_pact_agreed: I remember when we chose an agreement rather than imposing on each other.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_pact_kept_p: It was not a pleasant phrase. It was a decision you followed through on.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_pact_broken: I remember the difference between what we agreed and what you ended up taking.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_pact_withdr: You chose to withdraw that agreement. Recognizing your limits was not betrayal.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_episode_rev: We talked after you recovered the body. That does not erase what happened, but it lets us understand it.
dialogue.nydomod.bond.recall_repair_prog: Trust did not return all at once. There was a step I did recognize.

dialogue.nydomod.bond.debrief_death_p11_: I could not keep the body alive. I will not call that a victory or promise I can always save you.

dialogue.nydomod.bond.repair_finished_re: You respected the flow. I do not need another demonstration right away. Let this one mean something.
I saw you keep your word. Rebuilding this takes more than one loan after another.

dialogue.nydomod.personality.shukaku.gre: Well, human. How will you surprise me today?
dialogue.nydomod.personality.shukaku.exp: Earn my respect by following through. Excuses scatter in the wind.
Sand will not obey trembling hands. Practice and stand firm.
I want to get out, explore, and see what you can do.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.shukaku.sha: You followed through. Not bad, for a human.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.matatabi.ex: Small, consistent gestures tell me more than promises.
Breathe. If you force every movement, we will fight each other.
I prefer to move carefully and choose when to act.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.matatabi.sh: Thank you for listening. I will remember this.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.isobu.name: Isobu
dialogue.nydomod.personality.isobu.greet: I am here. We can take our time.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.isobu.expla: I need time to know you will not use me and then forget me.
Do not rush. Learn to stop before asking for more strength.
Let us find a quiet path; exploration teaches us too.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.isobu.share: I am glad we did this together.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.son_goku.gr: Speak respectfully and I will listen.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.son_goku.ex: Your word is worth what you do when keeping it costs you.
I am no tool. Our strength requires an agreement.
I want challenges we can face together.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.son_goku.sh: You kept your word. That matters.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.kokuo.name: Kokuo
dialogue.nydomod.personality.kokuo.greet: You may speak. There is no need to fill every silence.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.kokuo.expla: Consistency lets me lower my guard.
Measure your steps. Power without direction ends against a wall.
I would like to explore somewhere new without rushing.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.kokuo.share: You have been good company. Thank you.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.saiken.name: Saiken
dialogue.nydomod.personality.saiken.gree: How are you? We could rest a moment too.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.saiken.expl: Looking after each other on ordinary days builds trust too.
Listen to your body. Pushing harder does not solve everything.
Some food and a walk would do us good.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.saiken.shar: That was nice! I am glad we shared it.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.chomei.name: Chomei
dialogue.nydomod.personality.chomei.gree: Hey! What are we discovering today?
dialogue.nydomod.personality.chomei.expl: Let us do things together. I want memories, not only promises.
Find the rhythm. Even momentum needs to know when to turn.
Let us explore! There must be something we have not seen.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.chomei.shar: Another memory for both of us!
dialogue.nydomod.personality.gyuki.name: Gyuki
dialogue.nydomod.personality.gyuki.greet: I am listening. Tell me what you need.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.gyuki.expla: Keep our agreements and learn from mistakes. That is how we progress.
Master the basics first; then you can make use of all that strength.
Training, food, and rest: none of them is optional.
dialogue.nydomod.personality.kurama.name: Kurama
dialogue.nydomod.personality.kurama.shar: At least this time you did what you said. I will remember that.

village.nydomod.chat.iruka: Sometimes the most important lesson happens outside the classroom. You don't have to prove everything at once. There is always room for questions here.
village.nydomod.chat.kakashi: You're on time. I was… finishing a page. A good ninja knows when to stop and observe. The next strike isn't always the answer.
village.nydomod.chat.hokage: A tidy report cannot bring anyone home. I need verified routes, supplies that actually exist, and shinobi who know when to stop and help someone. Review the rank dossiers. I will receive your reports myself.
village.nydomod.chat.gate_captain: We see many teams leave through this gate. The best part of guard duty is seeing them come home together.
village.nydomod.chat.gate_guard: A quiet shift is a good shift. If you need your bearings, follow the avenue toward the academy.
village.nydomod.chat.ramen: Welcome! You can leave your worries at the door, at least until you finish your ramen.
village.nydomod.chat.medic: Rest matters too. I would rather see you here for a conversation than another bandage.
village.nydomod.chat.weapons: Equipment tells stories: a worn grip, a well-kept blade. Take care of your tools.
village.nydomod.chat.outfitter: A strong seam can save you a difficult afternoon. And no, not every uniform has to be too big.
village.nydomod.chat.scrolls: Every scroll holds the patience of someone who learned before us.
village.nydomod.chat.courier: After so many trips through these streets, I know who rises early and who forgets to close a window.
village.nydomod.chat.archivist: A name in these records is never just ink. There is someone the village remembers behind it.
village.nydomod.chat.innkeeper: There is room to rest. Some of the best stories begin when a team gathers around the table again.
village.nydomod.chat.patrol: All quiet here. Enjoy your walk; we are watching the streets.
village.nydomod.chat.resident: I like this time of day. The village has its own rhythm, even when the ninja are in a hurry.
village.nydomod.chat.envoy: Trust grows through small acts, repeated when nobody is watching.
village.nydomod.chat.florist: The garden flowers change with the light. Walk too quickly and you miss it.
village.nydomod.chat.baker: The oven has been warm since before dawn. The smell usually wakes the whole street.
village.nydomod.chat.trainer: Rest is part of training. One thoughtful step is worth more than ten blind strikes.
village.nydomod.chat.guildmaster: Every district supports part of the village. Knowing its neighbors teaches things no map can show.

gui.nydomod.companion.seal_repair_steps: Crouch and cast Four Symbols without aiming at another player. Stay still and crouched for 8 seconds to restore integrity to 100%.
gui.nydomod.companion.seal_extract_bind: First restrain the host with at least 3 settled chains from the same ninja, or with Shadow Imitation held by a different ninja from the extractor.
gui.nydomod.companion.seal_extract_chann: Within 4 blocks, aim at the host, crouch and cast Four Symbols. Stay still, crouched and in sight of the restrained host. An intact seal takes 12–18 seconds; severe damage can shorten this to about 4 seconds.
gui.nydomod.companion.seal_extract_inter: Losing restraint or contact, moving, standing up, taking damage or disconnecting interrupts the ritual. Damage already done to the seal remains.
gui.nydomod.companion.seal_ritual_cost: Extraction and reinforcement pay the technique’s normal casting cost, then 25 chakra per second while channeling. An interruption requires a short wait before retrying.
gui.nydomod.companion.seal_release_relat: The bijū becomes free; the extractor does not become its owner. Trust, shared experiences and tension influence whether it rampages, keeps its distance and only defends itself, or protects its former host against the extractor. Your relationship is remembered.
gui.nydomod.companion.seal_release_traum: Extraction leaves the host with at most 20% health, removes 75% of current chakra and causes 30 seconds of Weakness. It does not deliberately kill the host instantly.
gui.nydomod.companion.seal_capture_steps: Bring the bijū to 10% health or less: it will lie down, exhausted. Restrain it with 3 settled chains. Use the Four Symbols altar with a vessel at its center and at least 2 sealers. Keep all participants in place: with 2 sealers, the ritual takes 30 seconds.

mission.nydomod.konoha_hokage_d_inspecti: D · Four lights before the storm

Check the ramen, outfitter, courier and gate captain posts, in order. At each marker, crouch without moving or taking damage for 12 seconds. Speak to the courier, then bring 24 coal and 8 paper to Tsunade for the maintenance record. Do not break lanterns or alter buildings. One-time assessment after Promises do not fill a pantry.
Ramen → outfitter → courier → captain: crouch motionless for 12 s per post
mission.nydomod.konoha_hokage_c_triage.d: A patient appears when you accept. Escort them from Hokage headquarters to Aoi at the hospital; stay close and keep them safe. Speak to Aoi and deliver 16 white wool and 4 honey bottles to Tsunade. Ninja level 10, reputation 100, Four lights and Will of Fire turn-ins required. Repeatable every 20 minutes after reward; a dead patient requires a retry.
mission.nydomod.konoha_hokage_c_river.de: Survey the three riverbank posts shown by the compass, in order. Crouch motionless without damage for 20 seconds at each. Speak to Tenten and deliver 48 oak logs and 64 cobblestone as shoring reserves. Do not place or remove village blocks. Tsunade receives the report and materials. One-time assessment after The stretcher comes first.
mission.nydomod.konoha_hokage_c_river.su: Three river posts, in order: crouch motionless for 20 s at each
mission.nydomod.konoha_hokage_b_cipher.t: B · Ink that travels only at night
mission.nydomod.konoha_hokage_b_cipher.d: At ninja level 25 and reputation 200, survey the archivist, courier and gate guard posts at night, in order. Crouch motionless for 30 seconds at each; movement, damage or leaving the night window interrupts observation. Speak to the archivist and deliver 12 ink sacs and 32 paper. Requires The river leaves warnings. Repeatable 20 minutes after reward.
mission.nydomod.konoha_hokage_b_cipher.s: At night: archive → courier → guard; crouch motionless for 30 s per post
mission.nydomod.konoha_hokage_b_shadow.d: Learn Shadow Clone and keep the jutsu bound to you, including in your Jutsu Pack. Cast it personally at the three compass-marked river posts in order, with at least 10 seconds between credited casts. A clone casting on your behalf does not count. Deliver 24 redstone for signals and report to Tsunade. One-time assessment after Ink that travels only at night.
mission.nydomod.konoha_hokage_a_evacuati: Ninja level 45 and reputation 400. Escort the evacuee who appears upon acceptance to the inn. Also verify the hospital, courier and inn posts in order: crouch motionless for 30 seconds at each. Speak to the innkeeper and deliver 32 white wool and 32 baked potatoes. A dead evacuee cannot earn completion. Requires Three relays; repeatable 20 minutes after reporting to Tsunade.
Hospital → courier → inn: crouch motionless for 30 s per post
mission.nydomod.konoha_hokage_a_seal.des: Tsunade demands control before authorizing a larger operation. With your own learned Rasengan, form it personally at the three river posts in order, at least 10 seconds between credits. Stay on foot, grounded and free of recent damage. Keep the jutsu when reporting and deliver 24 amethyst shards and 32 copper ingots. One-time assessment after Nobody stays behind.
Ninja level 70 and reputation 650. Verify captain, hospital, archive, courier and guard, in order. Each link requires 45 seconds crouching, motionless and unharmed; flight earns no credit. Speak to Aoi and the captain. Deliver 4 golden apples and 64 white wool as emergency reserves. Requires Three pressure anchors. Repeatable every 40 minutes after reward. A logistics protocol; it does not summon Katsuyu.
Captain → hospital → archive → courier → guard: crouch motionless for 45 s per link
mission.nydomod.konoha_hokage_s_lastwatc: S · The last report before dawn

After turning in Katsuyu protocol, verify the captain's post by day, then the guard's at night: 45 seconds crouching motionless at each, in order. Demonstrate your own Shadow Clone and Rasengan at all three river posts; each technique follows its own order, with jutsu credits separated by 10 seconds. Speak to Kakashi and bring 32 paper and 8 ink sacs. Keep both jutsu when reporting to Tsunade. One-time final assessment.
Captain by day → guard at night: crouch motionless for 45 s at each
