codex.nydomod.entry.welcome.title: Your ninja guide
codex.nydomod.entry.welcome.p1: This book grows with you. Its index shows the lessons you can read now, based on your Ninja XP and your implanted eyes.
codex.nydomod.entry.welcome.p2: Open the index to choose a chapter. Use the arrows to turn pages, G to go to a page, and A− / A+ to change the text size. Atlas opens your map.
codex.nydomod.entry.welcome.p3: With a Sharingan, its chapter appears. As your Ninja XP increases, more explanations and chapters become available. Reading does not unlock abilities.
codex.nydomod.entry.identity.title: Your ninja identity
codex.nydomod.entry.identity.p1: The Ninja Card brings together your identity, progression and preparation. Your blood clan, equipped dōjutsu and learned techniques are different parts of that identity.
codex.nydomod.entry.identity.p2: Open the card, review your current information, then prepare the techniques you intend to use. This codex’s living record reads your current Ninja XP and the learned scrolls you carry.
codex.nydomod.entry.identity.p3: A clan name alone does not mean a jutsu is learned. An eye specimen in storage is not an implanted eye. Check the corresponding preparation or ocular screen.
codex.nydomod.entry.xp.title: Three kinds of progress
codex.nydomod.entry.xp.p1: Ninja XP develops your overall ninja progression. Your ninja level is the square root of that experience. Jutsu XP trains an individual technique; vanilla experience belongs to Minecraft’s own systems.
codex.nydomod.entry.xp.p2: Train through valid combat and complete missions that award Ninja XP. Practise a learned jutsu to develop that technique. Use the living record below to see your current values and the next reading milestone.
codex.nydomod.entry.xp.p3: Combat XP is bounded by the mod’s rules and server configuration. Repeated inputs or unconfirmed hits are not a promise of XP. A higher ninja level does not teach every technique automatically.
codex.nydomod.entry.clans.title: Blood clan and affiliation
codex.nydomod.entry.clans.p1: NYDO keeps blood-clan identity separate from village reputation and social affiliation. Your lineage can affect starting affinities and access to particular progression paths.
codex.nydomod.entry.clans.p2: Check your clan in the Ninja Card. Then review your actual natures, learned techniques and taijutsu style. Study the origin of a scroll before comparing it with another ninja’s copy.
codex.nydomod.entry.clans.p3: Sharing a village does not imply sharing a bloodline. Genetic access, learning, preparation and combat requirements still have their own rules.
codex.nydomod.entry.chakra.title: Read your chakra
codex.nydomod.entry.chakra.p1: Chakra is the resource used by many jutsus and special powers. A technique’s base cost is only its starting value: charge, origin and mastery can affect the actual expenditure.
codex.nydomod.entry.chakra.p2: Begin with a learned technique and enough chakra. Observe the chakra bar before and after a successful use, then compare its behaviour as you train. Keep a reserve for the next action.
codex.nydomod.entry.chakra.p3: Do not confuse chakra with stamina. Physical combat and special finishers may draw on different resources. A visible technique can still be unavailable because of cost, cooldown or context.
codex.nydomod.entry.control.title: Control before power
codex.nydomod.entry.control.p1: Chakra control and technique mastery contribute to how efficiently you act. Progression should be read through the current card, bars and technique information rather than inferred from visual size alone.
codex.nydomod.entry.control.p2: Practise one technique repeatedly, comparing its cost and result under similar conditions. Separate a change in charge from a change in mastery so you can understand what improved.
codex.nydomod.entry.control.p3: The codex never spends training points or changes your build. Use the corresponding progression screen to make an actual choice.
codex.nydomod.entry.movement.title: Travel like a shinobi
codex.nydomod.entry.movement.p1: NYDO connects ninja progression with movement abilities such as water walking and wall climbing. Their operation depends on your current ninja state and movement context.
codex.nydomod.entry.movement.p2: Practise beside a safe shore and a low wall before using these abilities over a ravine. Observe your resource bars, direction and the surface you are touching.
codex.nydomod.entry.movement.p3: A travel technique does not remove collision, unloaded terrain or mission conditions. A line on the atlas is a bearing, not a guaranteed walkable path.
codex.nydomod.entry.natures.title: Your chakra natures
codex.nydomod.entry.natures.p1: Fire, wind, lightning, earth and water are basic natures. NYDO assigns starting affinities through its own progression, including clan contributions; other disciplines have their own origins and access rules.
codex.nydomod.entry.natures.p2: Open your preparation and inspect which nature scrolls you actually own. A nature contains individual techniques: learning one does not mean every entry in that scroll is enabled.
codex.nydomod.entry.natures.p3: The technique archive includes real registered techniques for reference. An open reading page is not proof that your ninja owns that nature.
codex.nydomod.entry.origins.title: The origin of a technique
codex.nydomod.entry.origins.p1: A nature or bloodline scroll carries an origin. Native access, DNA access and borrowed access can have different rank ceilings, training behaviour and chakra modifiers.
codex.nydomod.entry.origins.p2: Read the origin shown in a learned technique’s living record. If a rank is blocked by origin, inspect your progression path before spending more time training that same copy.
codex.nydomod.entry.origins.p3: Two scrolls with the same name can have different ownership and origin. Transferring an item does not automatically transfer the right to use it.
codex.nydomod.entry.dna.title: DNA and inherited access
codex.nydomod.entry.dna.p1: NYDO treats DNA progression as a distinct source of access to inherited disciplines. That origin remains relevant after acquiring the associated item.
codex.nydomod.entry.dna.p2: Follow the DNA item’s own conditions and check your resulting preparation. Consult each learned technique’s origin and allowed rank in this archive.
codex.nydomod.entry.dna.p3: A DNA source is not a universal unlock. Learning, rank ceilings, ownership and resource costs continue to apply. Ocular surgery is a separate physical process.
codex.nydomod.entry.combat.title: Enter physical combat
codex.nydomod.entry.combat.p1: Combat mode enables NYDO’s physical fighting controls. Your active style, weapon, prepared jutsu and current state determine which action is accepted.
codex.nydomod.entry.combat.p2: Enable combat mode, select a target and begin with deliberate individual attacks. For unarmed combo practice, use a context without a selected jutsu. Watch the confirmed sequence in the combat HUD.
codex.nydomod.entry.combat.p3: A held button is not a stream of new combo inputs. Attacks can be rejected during recovery, at the wrong distance or without the required resources.
codex.nydomod.entry.combos.title: Read L / R as a rhythm
codex.nydomod.entry.combos.p1: Unarmed routes open with L, L. L is the attack input; R is the use input while an offensive branch is active. The HUD distinguishes confirmed, pending and queued steps.
codex.nydomod.entry.combos.p2: Basic routes include LLRR, LLRL and LLLR. Follow the routes for your current style. Uchiha fireball vault uses LLRLLR and also requires the real learned Great Fireball technique and the corresponding skill.
codex.nydomod.entry.combos.p3: Do not treat every right input as an attack: outside an offensive branch it can defend. Finishers still check skill, technique ownership, learning, origin and resources.
codex.nydomod.entry.defense.title: Guard, timing and openings
codex.nydomod.entry.defense.p1: Guard belongs to the defensive context of the use input. Parry depends on a short timing window; holding guard indefinitely is not repeated perfect defense.
codex.nydomod.entry.defense.p2: Release and time a fresh guard against an incoming attack. Watch stamina and recovery. In the defensive context, sneak plus attack while holding guard requests a grab.
codex.nydomod.entry.defense.p3: An offensive combo branch changes the role of the right input. Read the combat HUD before expecting it to defend, and do not assume a parry can cancel every state.
codex.nydomod.entry.air.title: Take the fight into the air
codex.nydomod.entry.air.p1: Aerial combat begins with an accepted launcher that actually hits. Follow-up routes depend on your style, unlocked skills and the resulting air-combat state.
codex.nydomod.entry.air.p2: Check the taijutsu tree for the launcher and pursuit available to your style. Practise the launcher first, then follow the combat HUD for the chase and finish.
codex.nydomod.entry.air.p3: A missed launch does not create a valid air route. Ground combos and aerial slams have different contexts; pressing the same sequence in empty air does not guarantee a finisher.
codex.nydomod.entry.taijutsu.title: Your taijutsu style
codex.nydomod.entry.taijutsu.p1: The taijutsu tree describes the skills and routes of the active physical style. Basic, Uchiha, Hyūga, Naruto, Rock Lee, toad sage and Kurama contexts do not all share the same finishers.
codex.nydomod.entry.taijutsu.p2: Open the tree, read a skill’s requirements and learn the movement associated with it. Test a short route before investing in a longer sequence.
codex.nydomod.entry.taijutsu.p3: The style and unlocked skill must match the requested move. An animation that resembles another style is not evidence that you have its gameplay ability.
codex.nydomod.entry.hyuga.title: Byakugan and Gentle Fist
codex.nydomod.entry.hyuga.p1: NYDO links Hyūga combat techniques to its taijutsu and ability systems. An installed Byakugan reveals this chapter, while the actual move still checks its own requirements.
codex.nydomod.entry.hyuga.p2: Review the Hyūga style and its learned skills. Open your current power selector and read the available entries; the living record below lists what the selector exposes now.
codex.nydomod.entry.hyuga.p3: Possessing a Byakugan does not automatically learn every Hyūga move. Eye state, style and skill checks remain distinct.
codex.nydomod.entry.learn.title: Learn before casting
codex.nydomod.entry.learn.p1: A scroll can define several jutsus while only some are learned. NYDO records each enabled technique on the actual scroll and respects its owner and origin.
codex.nydomod.entry.learn.p2: Use the corresponding learning scroll, teacher or progression reward, then check the Jutsu Pack. In this book, a learned technique carries a personal training record.
codex.nydomod.entry.learn.p3: A learned technique can begin at zero Jutsu XP. Training improves execution; it is not a universal initial permission to cast. Studying its reference page does not teach it.
codex.nydomod.entry.loadout.title: Prepare your Jutsu Pack
codex.nydomod.entry.loadout.p1: Preparation separates the techniques you know from the ones you carry into combat. The arsenal, active row and prepared techniques determine what the combat selection exposes.
codex.nydomod.entry.loadout.p2: Open the Ninja Card’s preparation, put the desired scrolls in your active row and select their prepared techniques. Use the scroll and technique controls to verify the current choice.
codex.nydomod.entry.loadout.p3: An owned technique can remain outside the active preparation. Finding it in the codex or in a pouch does not make it the currently selected jutsu.
codex.nydomod.entry.cast.title: Select, form seals, release
codex.nydomod.entry.cast.p1: NYDO techniques have their own casting behaviour. Some use hand signs or a charge, while special powers may have a dedicated activation context.
codex.nydomod.entry.cast.p2: Select the intended technique on the active scroll. Use it, allow its hand-sign sequence or charge to progress, and release when its casting mode requires it. Watch the HUD and test with space ahead.
codex.nydomod.entry.cast.p3: Changing selection or interrupting the action can cancel a cast. The generic technique reference is not a promise that every jutsu uses the same timing or targeting.
codex.nydomod.entry.mastery.title: Train the technique you use
codex.nydomod.entry.mastery.p1: Jutsu XP belongs to the individual technique on your scroll. NYDO also evaluates mastery, refinement and origin when calculating its behaviour.
codex.nydomod.entry.mastery.p2: Practise successful uses. Valid combat training can also train the selected technique in the supported held context. Compare your personal XP and ceiling in its technique page.
codex.nydomod.entry.mastery.p3: The definition’s base training reference can differ from the ceiling of your actual copy. Ownership, origin and server rules matter; merely holding a button is not proof of successful training.
codex.nydomod.entry.clashes.title: When jutsus collide
codex.nydomod.entry.clashes.p1: Compatible techniques can enter NYDO’s clash system. Its display reports the current contest and the input that the active situation expects.
codex.nydomod.entry.clashes.p2: Read the clash HUD when it appears and react to its current cue. Maintain awareness of your resources and the opponent’s position before committing to another cast.
codex.nydomod.entry.clashes.p3: Not every projectile collision is a clash. A cinematic or bright impact alone does not prove victory, damage or cancellation of the opposing technique.
codex.nydomod.entry.eyes.title: Two eyes, one real anatomy
codex.nydomod.entry.eyes.p1: NYDO keeps dōjutsu in its native ocular system, separate from the normal helmet slot. Left and right sockets, physical origin, installation and usability all matter.
codex.nydomod.entry.eyes.p2: Open your ocular configuration, select the eye you intend to use and activate it. This chapter’s living record identifies implanted eyes; the selector determines the currently exposed powers.
codex.nydomod.entry.eyes.p3: A removed, missing or unusable origin eye cannot be replaced by a name or cosmetic appearance. The codex reads the installed anatomy instead of guessing from your clan.
codex.nydomod.entry.sharingan.title: Your Sharingan
codex.nydomod.entry.sharingan.p1: Your implanted Sharingan reveals this dossier. The ordinary Sharingan catalog includes genjutsu, crows and copying; evolved eyes expose their own power sets.
codex.nydomod.entry.sharingan.p2: Activate the intended eye and inspect its power selector. The natural eye reaches two tomoe at %1$s eye XP plus one emotional milestone, and three at %2$s plus two milestones. These are not Ninja XP. Your actual tomoe and eye XP appear below.
codex.nydomod.entry.sharingan.p3: Tomoe progression belongs to the physical eye; only its natural owner advances it. A transplanted eye keeps its stage. Evolved powers and left/right origin requirements remain separate.
codex.nydomod.entry.copy.title: Observe and copy
codex.nydomod.entry.copy.p1: With a usable ordinary three-tomoe Sharingan active, observe another player’s successful eligible jutsu within %1$s blocks and clear line of sight. The eye stores a temporary pattern for %2$s seconds. Basic ninjutsu and the five basic elements are eligible types.
codex.nydomod.entry.copy.p2: Choose Copy in the active Sharingan’s selector. Hold its cast control to perform the copied hand signs, then release to use the stored technique. A new observation replaces the previous pattern.
codex.nydomod.entry.copy.p3: The stored copy is consumed after a valid release and also expires with time. It does not create a permanently learned scroll. Its power is capped at %3$s%% of the original maximum; chakra and execution conditions still apply.
codex.nydomod.entry.mangekyo.title: The eye’s own signature
codex.nydomod.entry.mangekyo.p1: Mangekyō variants do not all have the same abilities. NYDO reads the profile of the actual eye, including dynamic variants, instead of assigning a generic power set to the clan.
codex.nydomod.entry.mangekyo.p2: Select your implanted variant and consult the living power list. Check which origin eye each ability needs and monitor vision and fatigue during use.
codex.nydomod.entry.mangekyo.p3: Temporary blindness rules are specific to the eye type. Do not apply ordinary Mangekyō fatigue assumptions to every Sharingan or Eternal Mangekyō.
codex.nydomod.entry.susanoo.title: Susanoo and its forms
codex.nydomod.entry.susanoo.p1: Susanoo has its own progression, forms and native ability catalog. The powers offered depend on the active Susanoo state and the eye configuration that supports it.
codex.nydomod.entry.susanoo.p2: Use the native Susanoo controls, inspect your current form and open the power selector. Compare the available powers after a legitimate change of form.
codex.nydomod.entry.susanoo.p3: Reaching this reading page does not grant Susanoo. Physical eye requirements, progression, chakra and the particular form still determine what can be used.
codex.nydomod.entry.byakugan.title: Your Byakugan
codex.nydomod.entry.byakugan.p1: An implanted Byakugan reveals this chapter. NYDO connects its ocular utility with separate Hyūga combat abilities, so vision and a learned physical technique are not the same action.
codex.nydomod.entry.byakugan.p2: Activate and select the appropriate eye. Review the current power selector and use the taijutsu tree for the Hyūga combat route. The live record below follows your present configuration.
codex.nydomod.entry.byakugan.p3: Holding an eye item or wearing a cosmetic helmet does not substitute for physical installation. Check both anatomy and the skill required by the move.
codex.nydomod.entry.rinnegan.title: Rinnegan: read the active path
codex.nydomod.entry.rinnegan.p1: Rinnegan’s native catalog includes Shinra Tensei and a power that follows the selected path. Changing the path can change the meaning of that entry.
codex.nydomod.entry.rinnegan.p2: Select the real implanted Rinnegan, review the current path and inspect the living power list before casting. Use the game’s own feedback to distinguish selection from execution.
codex.nydomod.entry.rinnegan.p3: Reading a path’s name does not activate it. Eye usability, ability requirements, chakra and the current state remain authoritative.
codex.nydomod.entry.other_eyes.title: A different ocular inheritance
codex.nydomod.entry.other_eyes.p1: NYDO registers ocular profiles beyond Sharingan, Byakugan and Rinnegan. The installed item and its native power catalog determine the abilities, not a generic eye label.
codex.nydomod.entry.other_eyes.p2: Read the names of your installed eyes below, select the intended one and inspect its current powers. Ketsuryūgan, for example, has its own blood-related abilities.
codex.nydomod.entry.other_eyes.p3: A registered eye can exist without exposing a power in the current selector. Do not infer an ability from colour or appearance alone.
codex.nydomod.entry.surgery.title: Specimen, socket, recovery
codex.nydomod.entry.surgery.p1: Ocular transfer in NYDO tracks the real specimen and the body socket. Extraction, storage, transplantation and recovery belong to the native surgery flow.
codex.nydomod.entry.surgery.p2: Use the appropriate ocular interaction or clinic interface. Read which side and specimen are selected before confirming, then follow the recovery instructions shown by the game.
codex.nydomod.entry.surgery.p3: An eye’s origin can remain different from the socket where it is installed. Powers may require the left or right origin eye, or both; swapping labels does not recreate missing tissue.
codex.nydomod.entry.atlas.title: An atlas that keeps your trail
codex.nydomod.entry.atlas.p1: The atlas combines the world’s regional biome colours with observed surface terrain. Your observed surface is stored with the world, and changing zoom uses that archive at the new scale.
codex.nydomod.entry.atlas.p2: Drag to pan and use the wheel or + / − to zoom. C centres on you; F frames you and the selected destination. The Atlas button in this book also includes legitimate destinations from carried maps.
codex.nydomod.entry.atlas.p3: Observed terrain is sampled in four-block cells. Regional colour is context, not proof of exploration. A route line gives bearing, not pathfinding, and the book does not reveal an undiscovered Bijū.
codex.nydomod.entry.konoha.title: Find your place in Konoha
codex.nydomod.entry.konoha.p1: Konoha contains a gate, academy, hospital, shops, training areas, archives and the Hokage headquarters. Named residents provide their own services and dialogue.
codex.nydomod.entry.konoha.p2: Use your legitimately opened Konoha chart to reach the village. Explore on foot, speak to the relevant resident and check the mission information before leaving on an assignment.
codex.nydomod.entry.konoha.p3: Carrying a traded chart does not bypass its original opening conditions. The Hokage codex is hidden among the books in the upper private office; investigate a gold-lit spine with an empty hand.
codex.nydomod.entry.missions.title: Accept, fulfil, report
codex.nydomod.entry.missions.p1: NYDO missions can require deliveries, combat, dialogue, travel, escort or specific trials. The objective type determines what counts as progress.
codex.nydomod.entry.missions.p2: Read the giver, active objective, destination and reward. Accept through the native dialogue, complete the stated action and return to the correct person when a report is required.
codex.nydomod.entry.missions.p3: Items required for delivery may be consumed at the proper hand-in. Entering a location, defeating a different target or opening this book cannot replace the objective’s actual condition.
codex.nydomod.entry.reputation.title: The village remembers
codex.nydomod.entry.reputation.p1: Village reputation and wanted status affect how Konoha responds to you. Mission access can depend on standing as well as progression.
codex.nydomod.entry.reputation.p2: Check your village standing and read the reason given when a resident refuses an assignment. Complete available legitimate work and respect the village’s rules.
codex.nydomod.entry.reputation.p3: Ninja XP and reputation are separate values. A high level does not automatically remove a hostile or wanted state.
codex.nydomod.entry.hokage.title: The Hokage’s commissions
codex.nydomod.entry.hokage.p1: The Hokage headquarters contains distinct reception, council, strategy, medical and private-office spaces. Its commissions use NYDO’s mission and trial systems.
codex.nydomod.entry.hokage.p2: Approach the Hokage through the normal entrance, read the offered commission and inspect its current conditions. Keep the route, supplies and reporting requirements together in your preparation.
codex.nydomod.entry.hokage.p3: The codex is an archive, not a commission token. Finding it does not complete the Hokage’s trials or confer a village rank.
codex.nydomod.entry.jiraiya.title: Jiraiya’s six chapters
codex.nydomod.entry.jiraiya.p1: Jiraiya’s authored campaign advances through provisions, water practice, scouting, shadow clones, the spiral and the final journey. Earlier chapters prepare the tools needed later.
codex.nydomod.entry.jiraiya.p2: Follow the current chapter’s actual objectives. The final journey requires ninja level 25 and the campaign’s legitimate chart, passage and exploration conditions. Use its atlas destination when available.
codex.nydomod.entry.jiraiya.p3: Owning a scroll alone may not satisfy a learned-technique trial. Keep your own learned Shadow Clone and Rasengan available when the campaign asks for them.
codex.nydomod.entry.sage.title: The path to sage training
codex.nydomod.entry.sage.p1: Sage progression is a journey with its own teacher, places and conditions. Jiraiya’s campaign connects travel to the authored snowy and sage regions.
codex.nydomod.entry.sage.p2: Complete the active travel objectives and report to the correct sage teacher. Use the relevant progression and mode controls after the game actually grants access.
codex.nydomod.entry.sage.p3: The landscape and this chapter are guidance, not an automatic Sage Mode unlock. Arrival, learning and the active transformation are separate steps.
codex.nydomod.entry.biju.title: Read a Bijū map
codex.nydomod.entry.biju.p1: A Bijū map tracks the real free beast registered by the server, including its dimension and tail count. A loaded beast shows its current position; an unloaded beast shows its last confirmed location.
codex.nydomod.entry.biju.p2: Hold the map to update it, or use it to open the atlas. Its marker refreshes while the atlas is open. You can also carry it with the codex to consult the Bijū alongside your other destinations.
codex.nydomod.entry.biju.p3: The map has a 2% chance in desert pyramids, jungle temples, stronghold libraries, woodland mansions, ancient cities and bastion treasure chests. Tracking grants no ownership or seal; a sealed or dead beast stops being an available target.
codex.nydomod.entry.sealing.title: Sealing is a real process
codex.nydomod.entry.sealing.p1: Bijū sealing and jinchūriki progression use their own native conditions and interaction flow. Seeing a creature or carrying its map does not establish a bond.
codex.nydomod.entry.sealing.p2: Read the sealing tool and the game’s current prompts before starting. Prepare the required target, materials and state, then follow the actual sequence.
codex.nydomod.entry.sealing.p3: This chapter does not skip the encounter or manufacture a seal. Your bond chapter appears only when NYDO confirms a real bond.
codex.nydomod.entry.bond.title: Your bond, your dialogue
codex.nydomod.entry.bond.p1: NYDO has detected a real Bijū bond for your ninja. Dialogue, requests, containment and progression now belong to that relationship’s current state.
codex.nydomod.entry.bond.p2: Open the bond dialogue and inspect the actions offered. Check the living selector entries below for your current forms and requests.
codex.nydomod.entry.bond.p3: Bijū XP is its own progression. Ninja XP alone does not substitute for control experience, a valid request or the conditions of a manifestation.
codex.nydomod.entry.manifestation.title: Control the manifestation
codex.nydomod.entry.manifestation.p1: The native bond selector exposes available forms and their Bijū XP requirements. A manifestation and a return to human form have their own current-state checks.
codex.nydomod.entry.manifestation.p2: Read the selected form’s requirement, request it through the native power controls and observe the response. Use the return option when the manifestation is active.
codex.nydomod.entry.manifestation.p3: Large forms change reach and movement context. Do not assume a human combo or another creature’s attack is available just because the model is large.
codex.nydomod.entry.weapons.title: Weapons have their own context
codex.nydomod.entry.weapons.p1: NYDO includes physical weapons, thrown tools and special weapons. Holding one can change combat routing compared with an empty-hand style.
codex.nydomod.entry.weapons.p2: Read the item tooltip, check the weapon shop and practise a single use before combining it with movement. Keep the intended weapon in the correct hand.
codex.nydomod.entry.weapons.p3: A tool’s visual effect does not prove that it shares another weapon’s range, damage or recovery. The current item and action determine those rules.
codex.nydomod.entry.supplies.title: Prepare before leaving
codex.nydomod.entry.supplies.p1: Food, mission deliveries, equipment and scrolls compete for inventory space. The Jutsu Pack and supported pouch storage help organise techniques, but mission supplies remain physical items.
codex.nydomod.entry.supplies.p2: Read the active objectives, gather their exact items and leave free slots for rewards. Prepare food and equipment for the journey shown by your map.
codex.nydomod.entry.supplies.p3: A renamed substitute may not satisfy an objective that checks a specific item or data. Do not spend the supplies you still need to hand in.
codex.nydomod.entry.crafting.title: Crafting, shops and rewards
codex.nydomod.entry.crafting.p1: NYDO content can come from recipes, shops, learning scrolls, missions or exploration. These acquisition routes are different; not every registered item has a crafting recipe.
codex.nydomod.entry.crafting.p2: Check the recipe book for craftable items, the appropriate resident for stock, and the active mission for its actual rewards. Use the technique archive to identify the name you are looking for.
codex.nydomod.entry.crafting.p3: The codex does not invent a recipe for an uncraftable item or promise a universal vendor. The Hokage’s codex is discovered in the headquarters, not crafted from an ordinary book.
codex.nydomod.entry.multiplayer.title: Read what really happened
codex.nydomod.entry.multiplayer.p1: In multiplayer, NYDO confirms combat, progression and important interactions on the server. The HUD can show an input waiting for confirmation before its result is known.
codex.nydomod.entry.multiplayer.p2: Distinguish pending input from a confirmed hit. Read failure reasons, current resources and the active mission state before repeating an action.
codex.nydomod.entry.multiplayer.p3: The codex follows its current reader, even when the book is traded. Reading another ninja’s book does not copy their XP, implanted eyes, bookmarks or learned techniques.

codex.nydomod.technique.cast.sealed: Fixed-power technique: complete the required hand signs and release use. Holding longer does not turn it into a stronger charged technique.
codex.nydomod.technique.cast.toggle: Mode technique: follow its activation and deactivation feedback. Check the current state before using it again.

mission.nydomod.konoha_resident_ramen_pr: The academy students finish together today, and we are short on bowls. Bring me 12 carrots and 8 bowls. I will store the vegetables and prepare the counter when you return: hand in the materials here to collect your reward. Use materials you already own or gather them outside the village's protected perimeter; buying them is not required.
mission.nydomod.konoha_resident_bakery_f: The night patrol deserves warm bread too. I need 8 coal for the oven and 4 sugar for the glaze. Gather both and return to the bakery; I will take the materials when I pay you. Use materials you already own or gather them outside the village's protected perimeter; buying them is not required.
mission.nydomod.konoha_resident_clinic_f: I want to brighten the waiting room without getting in the way of treatment. Consult the medic and gather 2 flower pots and 6 dandelions. Then return to the florist. I will arrange them: hand the materials to me here, not to the medic. Use materials you already own or gather them outside the village's protected perimeter; buying them is not required.
mission.nydomod.konoha_resident_strap_re: Check the stitching before leaving, not after a pouch falls into the river. Consult the gate captain and gather 12 string and 4 leather. Return to the outfitter to hand everything in; the report will help me organize the repairs. Use materials you already own or gather them outside the village's protected perimeter; buying them is not required.
mission.nydomod.konoha_resident_practice: Guy needs sturdy bases for his next exercises. Speak with him at the dojo and bring 8 flint and 16 cobblestone to the weapons shop. I will prepare markings and counterweights; the materials are consumed when you report here. Use materials you already own or gather them outside the village's protected perimeter; buying them is not required.
mission.nydomod.konoha_resident_academy_: Iruka has a new class, and I do not want students sharing scraps of paper. Consult him and gather 16 sugar cane and 4 string. Return to the scroll shop to hand over the raw materials and collect your reward. Use materials you already own or gather them outside the village's protected perimeter; buying them is not required.
mission.nydomod.konoha_resident_archive_: An Index We Can Read Again

Some registry cards are faded, but their names must survive. Consult the scroll merchant and find 12 paper and 2 ink sacs. Return to the archive: I will receive the materials and rebuild the index. Use materials you already own or gather them outside the village's protected perimeter; buying them is not required.
mission.nydomod.konoha_resident_guest_be: A team is returning from a journey and needs rest. Speak to the courier to confirm their arrival, then bring 6 white wool and 12 oak planks. Hand them in at the inn when collecting your reward; I will prepare the beds without disturbing other guests. Use materials you already own or gather them outside the village's protected perimeter; buying them is not required.
mission.nydomod.konoha_resident_delivery: A kitchen note does not match the register. Consult the ramen cook and the archivist, and gather 12 paper for new copies. Return to me at the courier office; both reports and the paper are checked here before payment. Use materials you already own or gather them outside the village's protected perimeter; buying them is not required.
mission.nydomod.konoha_resident_gate_han: A Handover Starts with a Look

Before the shift changes, I need a quiet inspection. Visit the two marked posts west and east of the avenue just inside the gate. Speak to the guard and report back to the captain. This round stays inside the village; there is no need to seek combat.

mission.nydomod.konoha_guy_opening.title: Guy I · Before speed
mission.nydomod.konoha_guy_opening.desc: Guy: begin by listening to your strikes. In the basic style, approach a dummy and perform LL: two left clicks with two actual hits. Complete three openings. After each LL, let the chain disappear before repeating; learn to begin deliberately. Watch each contact confirmation. Missing, using weapons or casting jutsu does not demonstrate this lesson.
mission.nydomod.konoha_guy_cross.title: Guy II · The elbow opens, the palm closes
mission.nydomod.konoha_guy_cross.desc: Guy: two strikes create the opening; the ending uses it. In the basic style, complete LLRR twice on a dummy. Release R between its two presses. Cross break has two finishing contacts: only the final palm earns proof, not the animation starting. Stay close and face the wood. Wait at least six seconds between finishers to recover the move.
mission.nydomod.konoha_guy_palm.title: Guy III · One palm, one measured step
mission.nydomod.konoha_guy_palm.desc: Guy: advancing too far also costs your balance. In the basic style, execute LLRL twice: open with LL, follow with R and close with L. All four strikes must connect and finish the driving palm. Move close enough without passing through the dummy; keep your feet grounded. Take six seconds between finishers and readjust your distance.
mission.nydomod.konoha_guy_turn.title: Guy IV · The turn begins with your gaze
mission.nydomod.konoha_guy_turn.desc: Guy: the kick uses your whole body, but never lose sight of the target. In the basic style, complete LLLR twice: three confirmed left strikes and one right click for the turning kick. Do not hold R from the beginning. A miss or incoming hit requires recovery and a fresh chain. Respect the six-second interval between finishers.
mission.nydomod.konoha_guy_whirl.title: Guy V · The Leaf learns to turn
mission.nydomod.konoha_guy_whirl.desc: Guy: now, Lee's style. You need combat level 16 and Leaf Hurricane, with its prerequisites purchased in the tree. Select Rock Lee and complete LLRLLR twice against the wood. Six inputs: the last R must start Leaf Gale, and its sequence must reach the final hit. Entering the recipe with another style is not enough. Its own cooldown lasts ten seconds after the sequence.
mission.nydomod.konoha_guy_exam.title: Guy VI · Two endings, one decision
mission.nydomod.konoha_guy_exam.desc: Guy: your examination is choosing how to finish. You need combat level 20, Leaf Hurricane and Dynamic Entry. Select Rock Lee: confirm two Meteor Heel finishers with LLLR and one Leaf Gale with LLRLLR, in either order. Every ending must reach its final contact; chains from a cancelled lesson cannot be reused. Their cooldowns are independent: ten seconds after the Leaf Gale sequence and fourteen after Meteor Heel. Return to tell me which ending you controlled best.

village.nydomod.dialogue.mentor_nao: Care starts before anyone gets hurt. We will prepare a small medical kit; then you can help with the hospital rounds.
village.nydomod.dialogue.mentor_kaori: Good reconnaissance starts with your approach. I will show you how to move carefully, stop and survey the riverbank one step at a time.
village.nydomod.dialogue.mentor_ren: Each district knows part of the story. Check reports with the people responsible and learn how the village services connect.
village.nydomod.dialogue.mentor_daichi: We use the practice targets you already know. Order, angle and knowing when to step back matter more than swinging without thinking.
village.nydomod.chat.mentor_nao: Asking for help in time also protects your team. Check your medical kit before leaving; report anything that has changed when you return.
village.nydomod.chat.mentor_kaori: A steady pace leaves time to notice tracks, exits and changes in the terrain. You do not need to run to bring back a good report.
village.nydomod.chat.mentor_ren: The village works because someone checks that the message arrived. Clear confirmation beats assuming someone else will handle it.
village.nydomod.chat.mentor_daichi: Practice targets are not impressed by strength. Choose your target, adjust your position and leave room for the next move.
village.nydomod.mentor.other_lesson: You already have “%s” with this instructor. Finish it or cancel it from your ninja card before starting another.
mission.nydomod.konoha_mentor_clinic_sto: The clinic is preparing its next shift. Gather 2 white wool blocks and 1 honey bottle, consult the florist, then return to Nao. You hand over the supplies when reporting.
mission.nydomod.konoha_mentor_care_round: Nao wants to check on two neighbors. Follow the guide: stand still near the marked resident for 2 seconds, then speak to them. Repeat with the next resident and return to Nao.
mission.nydomod.konoha_mentor_recovery_w: A patient can leave the clinic but needs company. Walk beside them to the inn entrance. Once they arrive, return to Nao to report.
mission.nydomod.konoha_mentor_quiet_step: Kaori teaches you to approach quietly. Crouch-walk to the two marks on the garden crossing in the indicated order. Move into each mark, then return to Kaori.
mission.nydomod.konoha_mentor_steady_arr: Kaori wants each movement to end under control. Reach the first mark and stand still for 2 seconds. Do the same at the second mark, then return to Kaori.
mission.nydomod.konoha_mentor_river_samp: Kaori is recording activity along the river. Catch 2 fish at the marked bank and bring 2 sheets of paper. Return to Kaori; only the paper is handed over when reporting.
Fish caught at the river bank
mission.nydomod.konoha_mentor_relay_roun: Ren needs to confirm that a handover reaches its contacts. Speak to the 3 residents shown by the guide, one after another. Each confirmation reveals the next destination. Return to Ren.
mission.nydomod.konoha_mentor_supply_pou: Ren is preparing delivery supplies. Gather 4 sheets of paper and 2 strings, then confirm the job with the 2 marked residents in order. Hand the materials to Ren when you return.
mission.nydomod.konoha_mentor_street_lin: Ren wants to check a connection between shops. Speak to the first resident, cross the street mark, then speak to the second. Follow the guide's order and return to Ren.
mission.nydomod.konoha_mentor_target_ord: Daichi teaches you to choose a target before striking. Land one melee hit on each of the 3 marked dummies in order. The guide changes after each correct hit. Return to Daichi.
mission.nydomod.konoha_mentor_two_flanks: Daichi wants you to reposition between hits. Strike the marked dummy 4 times, alternating the indicated side. Stand at least 1 block from its center toward that side, then return to Daichi.
mission.nydomod.konoha_mentor_measured_r: Daichi teaches you to withdraw after attacking. Strike the marked dummy, then retreat to the mark. Complete 3 cycles with different dummies, following each guide update. Return to Daichi.

village.nydomod.mentor.runtime.settle: Reach the marker at %s and stay still for %s s.

village.nydomod.mentor.runtime.retreat: Walk away from the target to the retreat marker.
mission.nydomod.konoha_city_sealed_dispa: A medical dispatch arrived without route confirmation. Tsunade asks you to retrace it: speak to the courier, examine the signal and check a witness's account before visiting the archive. Protecting a village starts with listening to it.
mission.nydomod.konoha_city_river_readin: The archive reveals a signal route that has gone unchecked. Inspect three riverbank stations: reach each marker, crouch and watch the water without moving. Ren needs a field report to organize the Hundred Lanterns plan.
Survey three stretches and deliver the report
mission.nydomod.konoha_city_shelter_netw: Nao turns your report into a relief network. Confirm the hospital's capacity, then the inn's reception and finally the food supply. Bring 8 bread, 4 white wool and 2 honey bottles; they are handed over when you report to Nao.
Prepare the shelter network in order
mission.nydomod.konoha_city_last_messeng: The relief messenger has arrived exhausted. Accompany them from the post office to the hospital entrance without leaving them behind. Once they arrive, speak to the medic and return to the courier. Their life matters more than the report's speed.
mission.nydomod.konoha_city_signal_chain: Ren entrusts you with three signal stations. Follow the marked order. Beside each lantern, crouch and right-click it with an empty main hand. Bring 4 copper ingots, 4 redstone dust and 2 coal to hand over with your report.
Verify three signals and notify Ren
mission.nydomod.konoha_city_blind_spot.d: Kakashi wants to know whether you can open an escape route as well as strike. In this drill, hit the assigned dummy from the marked flank, withdraw six blocks on foot and repeat with the second target. Then hear his assessment.
mission.nydomod.konoha_city_blind_spot.c: Complete two strikes, withdrawals and assessment
mission.nydomod.konoha_city_village_rela: The guard will test the chain you prepared. Receive the guard's briefing, observe the village approach from the marker and confirm the assigned service before taking the relief report to the courier. Each response has its place; keep the order.
Coordinate the gate and service relief
mission.nydomod.konoha_city_thousand_lig: The Hundred Lanterns plan now has people behind every signal. Listen to Iruka and the medic, climb to the neighborhood lookout and quietly take in Konoha. Then visit Tsunade and submit your final report. This time, you will know what each light protects.
Hear the village and conclude Hundred Lanterns

village.nydomod.city.step.messenger_medi: The messenger has arrived. Confirm their reception with %1$s.

village.nydomod.city.step.signal_third: Final signal: crouch beside the marked lantern and right-click it with an empty main hand.
village.nydomod.city.step.blind_first: Strike the first dummy in melee from the %3$s side.
village.nydomod.city.step.blind_withdraw: Withdraw on foot to the marker; another hit does not replace the withdrawal.

village.nydomod.city.step.blind_withdraw: Complete the second withdrawal on foot to the marker.

village.nydomod.city.step.lights_iruka: Hear what this network means to %1$s.
village.nydomod.city.step.lights_medic: Ask %1$s about the messenger and the shelters.
village.nydomod.city.step.lights_view: Climb to the marked lookout. Crouch and face the Hokage tower for %2$s s without moving.
village.nydomod.city.step.lights_hokage: Present the Hundred Lanterns result to %1$s.
village.nydomod.city.reply.dispatch_cour: The dispatch arrived, but its circuit confirmation was missing. I will not blame the messenger; inspect the entrance lantern first.
village.nydomod.city.reply.dispatch_witn: I saw the relief runner pass with the delivery. Nobody confirmed the next stretch. The archive keeps the route; you can check it there.
village.nydomod.city.reply.dispatch_arch: The route was written down, but a paper route cannot answer for its neighbors. We will start by checking the riverbank.
village.nydomod.city.reply.river_report: Three readings, one checked route. Now we can assign responsibilities without sending anyone in blind.
village.nydomod.city.reply.shelter_medic: The hospital will first treat those who cannot continue. We need the inn to receive those who only need rest.
village.nydomod.city.reply.shelter_inn: There will be a place to rest here. Confirm the food distribution; an empty bed is not enough to care for someone.
village.nydomod.city.reply.shelter_suppl: The distribution is coordinated. Take the supplies to Nao and she will finalize the plan's reserve.
village.nydomod.city.reply.messenger_med: We received them in time. The report could wait; they needed someone walking beside them. Let the courier know.
village.nydomod.city.reply.signal_report: All three stations responded in order. We now have a circuit someone knows how to follow.
village.nydomod.city.reply.blind_report: Good. The second strike only mattered if you left an escape route after the first. Remember that when someone depends on you.
village.nydomod.city.reply.relay_guard: Relief acknowledged. Before requesting another response, check the approach from the observation marker.
village.nydomod.city.reply.relay_service: Service confirmed. The next watch will know whom to approach. Take this response to the courier.
village.nydomod.city.reply.relay_courier: Confirmation has returned to its source. A message that comes back is worth more than ten orders nobody could answer.
village.nydomod.city.reply.lights_iruka: At the academy we teach students to protect the village. You can now tell them about the people behind those words.
village.nydomod.city.reply.lights_medic: The messenger is resting, and the network has people responsible for it. Go to the lookout; the streets seem small from there, but you know their weight.
village.nydomod.city.reply.lights_hokage: Now you understand Hundred Lanterns. Its strength is that everyone knows who will answer. Submit your report; Konoha will remember your service.
village.nydomod.city.report: Route complete. Return to %s and submit your report.
village.nydomod.city.report_delivery: Route complete. Bring the supplies listed in your ninja card to %s and submit your report.
village.nydomod.city.handoff: Your report is recorded. Continue with %s: “%s”.
village.nydomod.city.finished: Hundred Lanterns completed. Tsunade gives you a record of your service; the neighbors who took part have more to tell you.
village.nydomod.city.keepsake.name: Chronicle of Hundred Lanterns
village.nydomod.city.keepsake.page:
Konoha stands on more than its walls.

A messenger arrived with someone beside them. A shelter had supplies. A signal received an answer.

This record honors the one who learned to care for the paths connecting our people.

— Hokage's Office
village.nydomod.city.epilogue.hokage: Hundred Lanterns is now part of your history with Konoha. Keep getting to know the people you protect.
village.nydomod.city.epilogue.iruka: I told the students about the relief operation. They were impressed that a ninja can also save the day by listening.
village.nydomod.city.epilogue.medic: I still remember how you accompanied the messenger. We value that kind of strength here.
village.nydomod.city.epilogue.courier: When I see the circuit confirmations, I remember your route. Thank you for closing it.
village.nydomod.city.epilogue.gate_capta: Your service is in the Hundred Lanterns record. The gate also needs to know who is on the other side of every signal.
village.nydomod.city.epilogue.mentor_ren: A list is not a network until someone checks its links. You did that with your own footsteps.

village.nydomod.core.scene.arrival.acade: Welcome to the Academy. Here you will learn to observe, listen and look after your teammates before leaving on missions. Your arrival is noted. Once you finish your introduction visits, return to the gate captain and report back.
village.nydomod.core.scene.arrival.offic: Konoha depends on the people who care for it every day. Get to know them and listen before acting. I have received your introduction; finish your remaining visits and report to the gate captain. Your first lessons will follow.
